    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.summand_count_add_stable_count_le (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) {l : List (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))} (hl : P.BasicDecomposition l) :
    l.length + (stableClasses (eulerWeight k P)).ncard ≤ (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard

    The basic summands and the stable simples contribute independent projective weights, giving the upper bound in the perpendicular rank formula.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.perpendicular_simple_count (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) {l : List (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))} (hl : P.BasicDecomposition l) :
    (semistableSimpleClasses (eulerWeight k P)).ncard = (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard - l.length

    The number of simple objects in the semistable perpendicular category is the ambient simple count minus the number of basic summands.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.basic_silting_summand_count (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) {l : List (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))} (hl : P.BasicDecomposition l) (gen : ∀ (X : TwoTerm R), P.InThick X) :
    l.length = (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard

    A two-term basic silting complex has exactly the ambient number of simple modules as its number of indecomposable summands.
